records.name: Croatian Operational Research Review
records.publisher: Croatian Operational Research Society, with Croatian university co-publishers
records.scope_notes: Original OR theory and applications, optimization, stochastic models, simulation, quantitative decision support and related methods. Computational studies and existing-data applications fit; the instructions require an original scientific contribution.

route.conditions: Ordinary journal submission, without conference attendance. Manuscripts should contain 10–12 pages including bibliography, with at most 30 references. Final accepted files must use LaTeX. Authors must supply proofreading confirmation; the instructions make proofreading their responsibility and do not require a paid provider.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the explicit no-author-fees policy; no mandatory society membership or conference registration is listed.

fee_evidence.note: The society author page explicitly excludes submission and publishing fees and says authors are not charged any fees for submitting or publishing.
Current submission instructions specify length, reference limit, final LaTeX and proofreading confirmation, without a priced service requirement.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty band assigned in diamond expansion; no inference of acceptance probability from citation impact or absent statistics.

records.name: SORT (Statistics and Operations Research Transactions)
records.publisher: Statistical Institute of Catalonia (Idescat), co-edited with Catalan universities
records.scope_notes: Original methodological or applied statistics and operations research, including computational or educational elements. Real application examples are encouraged. Suitable for decision-science methods, stochastic modeling and existing-data studies with a substantive statistical or OR contribution.

route.conditions: English-language original articles; registration through the RACO submission system is required. LaTeX is strongly recommended and revised source files may be required. The no-fee statement applies generally, rather than through a selective waiver or affiliation agreement.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the journal no-submission-or-publication-fee statement and author instructions; no membership or registration payment is listed.

fee_evidence.note: The Open Access Statement expressly excludes both manuscript submission and article publication fees.
Author instructions reconfirm no publication fees and describe electronic submission and peer review.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty band assigned in diamond expansion; no inference of acceptance probability from citation impact or absent statistics.

records.name: Operations Research and Decisions
records.publisher: Wrocław University of Science and Technology, Faculty of Management
records.scope_notes: OR methodology and quantitative decision-making applications, with explicit coverage of optimization, forecasting, simulation, game theory and decision support. Existing-data economic, social and management applications fit.

route.conditions: The journal describes itself as free of charge and its homepage explicitly excludes publication fees, but an unambiguous submission-fee statement was not located. Revised manuscripts must use LaTeX and the stated figure formats. Non-survey papers may have at most 35 references.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No page or membership charges are listed; submission and any compulsory ancillary charges still need explicit confirmation.

fee_evidence.note: The journal homepage prominently states no publication fee.
The university journal describes itself as open access and free of charge, financed by its Faculty of Management; it does not separately enumerate submission costs.
Instructions describe the submission and review process but do not explicitly rule out submission or ancillary charges.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty band assigned in diamond expansion; no inference of acceptance probability from citation impact or absent statistics.

records.name: ORiON
records.publisher: Operations Research Society of South Africa (ORSSA)
records.scope_notes: OR theory, methodological reviews, case studies and applications; explicit topics include queues, allocation, multicriteria decisions, optimization, reliability and computer simulation. Particularly oriented toward practitioners and problems in Southern Africa or comparable settings, so regional relevance must be explained.

route.conditions: The section headed Submission Fees excludes APCs and page fees, but does not expressly name a submission charge. No society membership condition is stated. Ordinary research articles are open to submission; special-issue articles require invitation. Letters are a distinct section and should not inherit the research-article peer-review claim.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Page fees explicitly absent; no required membership payment is stated. Separate submission-fee confirmation remains unresolved.

fee_evidence.note: The official journal page states that it charges neither APCs nor page fees, under a Submission Fees heading. This supports free publication but leaves the literal submission-fee wording incomplete.
Submission checklist and guidelines do not state a membership payment or other mandatory charge.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty band assigned in diamond expansion; no inference of acceptance probability from citation impact or absent statistics.

records.name: RAIRO - Operations Research
records.publisher: EDP Sciences, in partnership with SMAI and scientific participation of ROADEF
records.scope_notes: Pure and applied OR, including mathematical programming, graph algorithms, scheduling, logistics, decision support, and deterministic, stochastic and robust models. Society scope supports original theoretical, methodological, algorithmic and application studies.

route.conditions: Library-supported Subscribe to Open route, confirmed for the 2026 volume. Publisher policy applies to authors regardless of whether their institution subscribes; this is not an individual waiver. Open-access status is reconsidered annually, so recheck for the eventual publication year. Journal author-instruction pages returned HTTP 403; detailed length and production instructions were not inspected.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for mathematics S2O journals in the publisher free-publication policy; no author membership or institutional-subscription requirement.

fee_evidence.note: Publisher policy expressly excludes submission fees across its journals and lists RAIRO - Operations Research within the S2O programme.
The current FAQ identifies RAIRO in the mathematics programme and says authors publish in these mathematics journals open access free of charge; A&A page-charge exceptions are separately identified.
The publisher 11 June 2026 update confirms that RAIRO - Operations Research reached the threshold for open access publication of its 2026 content.
Publisher programme page identifies RAIRO and states that no-APC S2O applies even to submissions from institutions without an S2O subscription.
Journal-specific author instructions could not be read because the site returned HTTP 403.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty band assigned in diamond expansion; no inference of acceptance probability from citation impact or absent statistics.

notes: Five additional journals; names and IDs were checked against the ten discovery records. No preprint or repository routes added.

Croatian Operational Research Review, SORT and the current 2026 RAIRO S2O route have explicit applicable evidence for free submission and publication. Operations Research and Decisions and ORiON retain needs_verification because separate submission-fee wording is incomplete.

No acceptance probability or difficulty band inferred. SORT official editorial statistics are at https://www.idescat.cat/sort/stats.html ; ORD reports rolling statistics at https://ord.pwr.edu.pl/ . Referred to ranking auditor separately.

YUJOR was investigated but not included among the five: current University of Belgrade pages establish fit and peer review, but current explicit fee policy was not found; the former yujor.erc.fon.bg.ac.rs policy host failed DNS, and DOI Serbia timed out. DOAJ and Diamond Discovery Hub reports alone were not promoted to verified_free.

RAIRO current publisher fee evidence was established despite blocked journal instructions; its annual S2O condition must remain visible. Independent agent research is not venue endorsement or human scientific review.
